title: SRV Studio (SRV English) V1 avatar collection — rollback manifest
configText:

     baseUrl:'/assets/avatars/',
     avatars:[
       {file:'SRV_Face_01_GoldenField.png',name:'Golden Field'},
       {file:'SRV_Face_02_RainStreet.png',name:'Rain Street'},

v2Behaviour: V2 adds a separate collection at public/assets/srv-studio-v2/avatars/concept/ and a separate registry (lib/srvStudioV2Avatars.mjs). It never deletes, moves, renames or edits the files above, never edits avatarLibrary, and never advances srvEnglishAvatarIdx. Published videos keep their baked-in images.
rollback: Flag OFF (delete or set false app_settings.srv_studio_v2_enabled): the V1 avatarLibrary and pointer are used exactly as before; nothing to restore.
If V2 code were ever merged and must be removed: git revert the V2 commits; the files above are byte-identical to the blobs listed (verify with sha256).
Restore a file: git show <ref>:<path> > <path> and compare sha256 with this manifest.
